items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: Oh, sure, we all met him. Sure.

ctx.x: Do you remember, was Jimmy Johnson older than you? I guess he was.

Oh, yeah. Jimmy, Jimmy, Jimmy Johnson, yeah, I used to sing. Oh, sure, we all met him. Sure. Of course. Jimmy Johnson, well, he played all right. He used to play with Jack Carey, you know. He played with the Crescent Band, you know. I love the Crescent Band. Yeah, and before he played with the Crescent Band, he used to play with, um. Play with Bolden. Buddy Bolden. Buddy Bolden.
Did you ever hear Bolden's band, that's one year?
